text: つり　まくっとる　かね！

structure.jp: つり　まくっとる　かね！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on these days. とる is an old-man and dialect way of saying ている. まくっとる = 'are doing it like mad'.

patterns.name: 〜まくる
patterns.explanation: まくる after an action means doing it like crazy, over and over. つりまくっとる = 'are fishing like mad'.

patterns.name: 〜かね
patterns.explanation: かね at the end is how an older man asks a friendly question to someone younger. まくっとるかね = 'are you doing lots of it, eh?'.
